paper_title: A Model-Independent Radio Telescope Dark Matter Search in the L and S Bands
notes: This paper sets model-independent limits on the dark matter decay rate (lambda ~ 1e-32 s^-1) and annihilation cross section (<sigma v> ~ 1e-30 cm^3/s) for radiative DM-to-radio-line processes over 1020-2700 MHz. The reported quantities are decay rate and velocity-weighted annihilation cross section, NOT a standard particle-physics coupling (g_agamma, chi, etc.) on the exclusion plot y-axes (Fig 8/9 show lambda [s^-1] and <sigma v> vs frequency). The hint of AxionPhoton does not match: the result is generic and not expressed as g_agamma. No coupling type in the enum applies. The NFW local density used is 0.471 GeV/cm^3 (Burkert 0.487). Could not extract (mass, coupling) pairs because no coupling constant is reported; data are decay rate / cross section limits which fall outside the requested coupling enum.
